_comment: Divisions are configured here. Create judge panels on the Panels tab after you know
how many judges are available; the interface assigns each new panel a unique login code.
`booking` sets the bookable time slots every panel starts with. startTime is a
24-hour clock time on the day the panels are created; set exact dates later in
Admin > Panels if you need to. Set slotCount to 0 for a walk-up queue only.
A panel can override any of these with its own slotMinutes / slotCount / startTime.
`languages` are the languages interviews run in. A team asks in one of them,
and each panel says which it can cover; a request that lands on a panel not
covering it is flagged rather than blocked, so you can still reassign.
`teamCategories` is the notebook classification. The FIRST one listed is what
a team gets until someone says otherwise — put `ungraded` first if you would
rather teams start unclassified and be graded up. Rename the labels or change
the colours to suit your event; keep the ids stable once teams are assigned.
